title: Closures of connected sets and the disjoint-union description of the connected components
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects the basic properties of connected components (author lemma at source lines 874-885, label lemma-connected-components): closures of connected sets are connected, components are closed, every connected subset lies in a unique component, and the space is the disjoint union of its components. The proof (source lines 887-920) proves the closure statement by splitting a putative separation of the closure and pulling it back to the connected set (proof lines 888-892), then uses the standard result that a union of connected sets with a common point is connected to define the maximal connected set through a point (proof lines 894-917), and finishes by exhibiting the counterexample to openness of components (proof lines 918-919). The numbered list is the reference point for the rest of the connectedness section. H2.
